notes.subject: תחשים
notes.rationale: phoofolo yeo e sa tsejwago ka botlalo — 'ditakhase' ka tsela ya modumo; ditlhahlo tše dingwe: 'dikgobo tša lewatle' (ASV sealskins), 'diphoofolo tša naga'

notes.subject: תולעת שני
notes.gloss: phukgwe ya karmine — bosweu bja phukgwe bja tola-e-kgubedu; mebala ya tempele e swanetše go dula ka tsela ya modumo

notes.subject: lenaneo la dikgabo
notes.rationale: lenane la dikgabo tše supilwego bakeng sa tente — mesebete e hapilwego ya Seheberu

translation: Gomme motho yo mongwe le yo mongwe yo go hweditšwego le yena tekhelete le argamane le phukgwe ya šani-bosweu le linene le boya bja dipudi, le matlakala a dipudi-namane tše mmidi-mmadimo a mebereke, le matlakala a ditakhase — ba di hlahlela.

tokens.gloss: gomme motho yo mongwe le yo mongwe

tokens.marks: dikgabo tša mebala — tše di ba le yena
